pages.title: Extended resources in side configuration
pages.text: Open the machine's Mekanism side-configuration window. Resource pages sit beside Items, Fluids and ENERGY and appear only when their supporting mod is loaded. Chemicals use Mekanism's native chemical-side icon; other pages show centered representative items from their mods. Blue exports; grey disables. Auto-eject sends to compatible neighbors, while supported pipes can pull with it off. Air supplies safely. FE uses the native ENERGY page or configurator: INPUT charges the battery, OUTPUT exports products, INPUT_OUTPUT supports both, and NONE disables. Separate containers protect operating power.

pages.title: Cards and upgrades
pages.text: Settings survive saves, tier installers, dismantling/mining machine items and crafting upgrades. Shift-right-click with a Mekanism configuration card to copy and right-click a compatible machine to paste. Only faces and auto-eject settings are copied, without resource accounts, balances or EMC recipients. Multi-input crafting keeps the first settings.

pages.title: Keep defaults first
pages.text: A first playthrough does not require editing configuration files or memorising raw option names. Open the mod list, select Productive Bees Genesis, and choose Configure. The translated screen groups everyday choices into Gameplay, Machines, Capacity, and Client Settings.

pages.title: Machine settings
pages.text: Use the Apiary or Centrifuge Basic Settings pages for power use, processing time, and fluid capacity. PB Upgrade Limits controls how many bee upgrades fit. Keep Multi-fluid Tanks enabled unless a modpack has a specific reason to combine fluids. Test changes on one normal machine before a factory.

pages.title: All-source production
pages.text: Gameplay's apiaryProduceAllFlowers defaults to off and is enabled by Paradox Infinity. Each cycle produces every distinct valid feeder source; empty or disabled slots and duplicates add no runs. Independent fluids are not multiplied. To edit this rule separately, switch and save as Custom first; that transition inherits the active preset's values.

pages.title: Acceleration budget
pages.text: Process 2048 virtual ticks per real tick by default, up to 4096. Bank capacity defaults to 8192, up to 32768. A larger bank buffers bursts without raising the processing rate. High MSPT reduces the budget. Existing settings keep their values.

pages.title: Per-apiary treat restocking
pages.text: AE2 gene-treat restocking is saved per apiary and defaults to off. Put a sample in the dedicated treat slot and enable R below it. The online network supplies only the same item with identical components, including genes, values, purity and name. R is independent of balance presets, A output and centrifuge I input.

pages.title: AE2 and performance
pages.text: Item output, fluid output, and network power normally work well at their defaults. Centrifuge auto-input is also enabled per machine from its AE2 Input window. If a large network stutters, lower the pull amount or increase the pull interval instead of maximizing every speed and parallel setting.

pages.title: Change settings safely
pages.text: Leave the world or stop the server normally, back up the world and configuration, then change one related group and record the old value. Re-enter with one test machine and check power, speed, items, and fluids. Restore that group if behavior is unexpected.

pages.title: Raw files are advanced
pages.text: Raw option names are useful only for pack distribution, scripting, or migration. World gameplay, machine, and capacity settings live in the world's server configuration directory; client visuals and custom window positions affect only the local player. Prefer the current screen labels and generated comments over old file examples.

pages.title: Create a resource bee
pages.text: Start with apiary → comb → Genesis extended resource centrifuging → hydrogen. Built-in types are examples; any valid registered AEKey, including another mod's custom resource, can use generic ae_key outputs. New types without AEKeys need an adapter.
Examples are separate from the release JAR. Download version-matched datapack and resourcepack folders from the repository for bee data and client names.

pages.title: Choose a route
pages.text: hydrogen produces combs; energy produces FE directly. energy_comb is a separate comb bee. createComb enables appearance; it does not create a hive recipe.

pages.title: 1. Install the datapack
pages.text: Put datapack in the world's datapacks folder, with pack.mcmeta and data at its root. Enable resourcepack in every client's resourcepacks folder, with pack.mcmeta and assets at its root. Formats are 48 and 34. Development runClient loads both.

pages.title: Add names with each bee
pages.text: Names live in assets/productivebees/lang. For example:hydrogen use entity.productivebees.hydrogen_bee in both languages. PB uses the fixed productivebees prefix and bee path, not example. Rename recipes and language keys together. Enable the pack and reload with F3+T.

pages.title: 2. Define the bee
pages.text: data/example/productivebees/hydrogen.json defines example:hydrogen. primaryColor and secondaryColor are colors; flowerBlock is minecraft:iron_block and createComb is true. Re-enter after adding a bee.

pages.title: 3. Produce combs
pages.text: Put hydrogen_honeycomb.json in data/example/recipe. Type: productivebees:advanced_beehive. ingredient: example:hydrogen. Output configurable_honeycomb with productivebees:bee_type = example:hydrogen.

pages.title: 4. Centrifuge hydrogen
pages.text: hydrogen_centrifuging.json uses productivebeesgenesis:resource_centrifuging and bee: example:hydrogen. Output kind: chemical, id: mekanism:hydrogen, amount: "100", chance: 1.0. processing_time is 20.

pages.title: Run the machines
pages.text: Put the hydrogen bee and iron-block flower in a powered mechanical apiary, then use a Genesis centrifuge. Base yield: 100 mB per comb or four portions per block. Examples add no spawning; add PB breeding/conversion for survival.

pages.title: Extended output support
pages.text: Genesis extended resources do not yet support PB's own hives or centrifuges. Use Genesis mechanical machines. Ordinary PB outputs still work. Related cages, eggs, combs and bee slots show a notice without Shift. Report extension issues to Genesis, not PB upstream.

pages.title: Export directly to ME
pages.text: Install AE2 and Applied Mekanistics, cable the centrifuge directly, and provide power, a channel and chemical storage. The Extended resources side tab shows amounts awaiting output; exported resources appear in ME. No extra block is needed.

pages.title: Read-only resource icons
pages.text: Extended resources defaults to Production; switch to Pending stock when needed. Rates use actual successful production over five seconds, including upgrades and acceleration. Observed resources remain visible without stock or after combs return to ME; rates reach zero when stopped. Only an open window synchronizes changes; Jade receives no rates. Chemical gauges show pending stock. Eject tries ME or adjacent storage and keeps rejected output. Icons cannot be taken; exported stock appears in ME.

pages.title: Direct FE
pages.text: Use energy.json and energy_production.json with a copper-block flower. resource_production outputs kind: energy, energy_type: FE, amount: "1000". No centrifuge is required. ME needs AE2 and Applied Flux. Output FE is separate from operating power.

pages.title: Direct EHV lightning
pages.text: Use lightning_ehv's two files. Output kind: lightning, tier: extreme_high_voltage, amount: "1000". Install AE2 Lightning Tech and matching storage. HV uses high_voltage. Voltages never convert.

pages.title: Editable fields
pages.text: amount is a positive integer string; chance is 0..1. 20 ticks = one second. Rename files and all bee, ingredient and bee_type references together. flowerTag omits #. Machines apply block portions and upgrades.

pages.title: Comments and KubeJS
pages.text: JSON examples use _comment; do not use // in JSON. Keep bee definitions. Put matching JS in kubejs/server_scripts, remove replaced recipe JSON, and /reload. hydrogen.js replaces two recipes; energy.js demonstrates three for two bees.

pages.title: Mixed output
pages.text: mixed keeps PB hive and direct-resource recipes. mixed_essence demonstrates conversion. combined sets include_pb_outputs: true with a matching PB centrifuge recipe. Consume input and power once; missing ordinary recipes pause.

pages.title: Other resource bridges
pages.text: Source: Ars Nouveau + Ars Energistique. Souls: Industrial Foregoing Souls + Soulplied Energistics. Air: PneumaticCraft + Applied Pneumatics. XP: ExperienceLib + Applied Experienced. ME also requires AE2 and compatible storage.

pages.title: Native resources
pages.text: 1000 raw air units equal 1 L. Seal leaks. EMC automatically credits the owner's ProjectE account without ME or an EMC-ME addon. Amounts remain exact up to 4096 digits; Project Expansion supplies its short display format when installed. Native capabilities remain available for external extraction. Produced FE can be ejected separately from operating power.

pages.title: Multiplayer EMC recipient
pages.text: The Recipient button appears only with ProjectE and FTB Teams. The owner or an operator can click Recipient in the resource window to cycle online teammates and the owner, even with no pending output. Hover for identity and status. Offline, removed or unavailable recipients retain EMC in the machine until eligible again. Unknown writes are quarantined; notification retries never add EMC again.

pages.title: Troubleshooting
pages.text: Missing bee: check folders, IDs and JSON, then re-enter. Waiting for flowers: check input and switch. No ME output: read the panel and check bridges, power, channels and storage. Ordinary item cells cannot hold chemicals or lightning. When an extended resource has no usable output or its pending allowance is full, mechanical centrifuges move the original combs into persistent return custody, send them back when ME accepts them and pause new pulls of that input. Output recovery resumes pulling automatically. Paid cycles retain their recipe, seed and complete input identity; unknown consumption or acceptance remains quarantined without replay.

pages.title: Generic keys and Java
pages.text: ae_key uses AE2's ae2:i key for diamonds. Other types need actual type, id, complete data and string amount. Generic resources use ME. Java authors can use ResourceBeeApiExample.java; pack authors can use JSON/KubeJS.

pages.title: Other machines and recovery
pages.text: Useless 2.4.6 natively accepts deterministic resource centrifuging: use a PB centrifuge mold, AE2, a key bridge and storage. Furnace rules apply. Official JDTE 0.6.4.3 still needs a hook; local API v3 only supplies recipe results and uses its existing cycle buffer and AE output upgrade. Unknown acceptance pauses retry. Genesis no longer reads .session markers. Unknown production pauses its lane and unknown output its resource; other work continues. Missing-resource combs are excluded from Myriad and input, while existing combs enter return custody. Corrupt data and real save failures still retain assets. Separate stores do not commit atomically. Third-party hosts use their own rules.

pages.title: Containers as flowers
pages.text: Mechanical apiaries and factories can match item contents. Add flowerResource to the bee JSON: kind chemical, id mekanism:hydrogen and amount "1000". Use a capable tank or bucket containing enough hydrogen. Empty, wrong-resource and insufficient containers fail. Remove legacy flower fields.

pages.title: Fluids, FE and generic keys
pages.text: fluid uses a fluid ID; energy uses energy_type FE. Fluid and chemical IDs accept #tags. ae_key uses the complete key and a real filled ME cell; wrapped icons do not count. Legacy flowerFluid also accepts capable containers. Other native items need the relevant capability.

pages.title: Reusable container flowers
pages.text: amount is a minimum, default "1". Pollination consumes neither content nor item. Stacks and feeder slots are not pooled; one native tank must qualify. JEI uses an AE2 cell with the resource and minimum; compatible display cells contain the resource. Gas buckets, chemical tanks and capable containers match their contents. Disabled slots fail immediately; contents refresh by the next real tick. Genesis mechanical hosts only.
The repository also includes container_water, container_energy and container_ae_key with both language files. KubeJS recipes are unchanged; flower rules stay in the bee JSON.
